The 8 BATT5 ids of these mods are not repeated here, and CRT_EXPANSION (18 rows) is part 2 (AUTO-262). Two rows are hand rows (afs_eidolon_derringer, laser_rifle_dino2: AUTO-239 #3 and #6, hand_fallback true).
